info.longBusinessSummary: LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of optoelectronic semiconductors in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. It also manufactures and sells indium phosphide and gallium arsenide epi-wafers and chips, and laser diode and light-emitting diode products. It serves telecom, data center, consumer, and industrial and medical industries. LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.
